#!/bin/bash
# Open77 dedicated server - Pelican egg installation script
# Runs inside ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/installers:debian with the egg variables
# exported in the environment. The server directory is /mnt/server.
set -euo pipefail

export SERVER_DIR=/mnt/server
mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR"
cd "$SERVER_DIR"

echo "[op77] Writing helper scripts"
cat > "$SERVER_DIR/op77-updater.sh" <<'__OP77_UPDATER__'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# op77-updater.sh - Open77 dedicated server release helper for Pelican Panel
#
# Talks to the official Open77 release pointer API on the CDN:
#   stable   : <CDN>/server/latest.json
#   unstable : <CDN>/server/unstable/latest.json
# Both pointers advertise immutable archives under <CDN>/server/<version>/.
#
# Commands:
#   install   Install the resolved release (latest for the channel, or the pinned
#             SERVER_VERSION). Skips when that exact version is already installed.
#   check     Query the API, print the latest release and whether it is newer than
#             the installed build. Exit 0 = up to date, 3 = update available.
#   update    Install the latest release when it is newer than the installed one.
#   boot      What the start script runs: make sure a build exists, check the API,
#             notify (console + optional webhook) and auto-update when enabled.
#   status    Print the installed release.
#   config    Create server.jsonc when it is missing.
#
# Environment (all provided by the egg variables):
#   RELEASE_CHANNEL   stable | unstable                       (default: stable)
#   SERVER_VERSION    latest | exact version to pin            (default: latest)
#   AUTO_UPDATE       1 = install newer builds at boot         (default: 0)
#   VERIFY_CHECKSUM   1 = verify archiveSha256 from the API    (default: 1)
#   UPDATE_WEBHOOK_URL Discord-compatible webhook for notices  (optional)
#   CDN_URL           release CDN origin                       (default: https://cdn.open77.dev)
#   SERVER_DIR        install directory                        (default: current directory)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set -euo pipefail

OFFICIAL_CDN="https://cdn.open77.dev"
LEGACY_CDN="https://cdn.open2077.net"

CDN_URL="${CDN_URL:-$OFFICIAL_CDN}"
CDN_URL="${CDN_URL%/}"
[ "$CDN_URL" = "$LEGACY_CDN" ] && CDN_URL="$OFFICIAL_CDN"

RELEASE_CHANNEL="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_CHANNEL:-stable}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
SERVER_VERSION="${SERVER_VERSION:-latest}"
AUTO_UPDATE="${AUTO_UPDATE:-0}"
VERIFY_CHECKSUM="${VERIFY_CHECKSUM:-1}"
UPDATE_WEBHOOK_URL="${UPDATE_WEBHOOK_URL:-}"
SERVER_DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-$PWD}"
PLATFORM="linux-x64"
BINARY="Open77.Server"

STATE_FILE="$SERVER_DIR/.op77-release"
WORK_DIR="$SERVER_DIR/.op77-work"
BACKUP_DIR="$SERVER_DIR/.op77-backups"
USER_AGENT="open77-pelican-egg/1.0 (+https://github.com/scotthowson/open77-pelican-egg)"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- output
c_reset=$'\033[0m'; c_info=$'\033[1;36m'; c_ok=$'\033[1;32m'; c_warn=$'\033[1;33m'; c_err=$'\033[1;31m'
log()  { printf '%s[op77]%s %s\n' "$c_info" "$c_reset" "$*"; }
ok()   { printf '%s[op77]%s %s\n' "$c_ok" "$c_reset" "$*"; }
warn() { printf '%s[op77] WARNING:%s %s\n' "$c_warn" "$c_reset" "$*" >&2; }
err()  { printf '%s[op77] ERROR:%s %s\n' "$c_err" "$c_reset" "$*" >&2; }
die()  { err "$@"; exit 1; }

banner() {
    local line
    printf '%s' "$c_info"
    printf '============================================================\n'
    for line in "$@"; do printf '  %s\n' "$line"; done
    printf '============================================================\n'
    printf '%s' "$c_reset"
}

is_true() { case "$(printf '%s' "${1:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in 1|true|yes|on) return 0;; *) return 1;; esac; }

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- tiny JSON helpers
# The pointer is a small, flat document with a known shape, so we avoid a jq
# dependency (the runtime yolk image does not ship it). Values never contain
# quotes, so simple extraction is safe. First match wins.
json_flat()   { tr -d '\n\r' ; }
json_str()    { printf '%s' "$1" | grep -oE "\"$2\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"[^\"]*\"" | head -n1 | sed -E 's/^"[^"]*"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(.*)"$/\1/'; }
json_num()    { printf '%s' "$1" | grep -oE "\"$2\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*-?[0-9]+" | head -n1 | grep -oE -- '-?[0-9]+$'; }
json_object() { printf '%s' "$1" | grep -oE "\"$2\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\{[^{}]*\}" | head -n1 | sed -E 's/^"[^"]*"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\{(.*)\}$/\1/'; }
json_escape() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g' | awk 'BEGIN{ORS="\\n"} {print}' | sed 's/\\n$//'; }

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- versions
valid_version() {
    # 2.31.21+op77.138  or  2.31.21-unstable+op77.128
    [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-unstable)?\+op77\.[0-9]+$ ]]
}
version_is_unstable() { [[ "$1" == *-unstable+* ]]; }
version_semver()      { printf '%s' "${1%%[+-]*}"; }
version_build()       { printf '%s' "${1##*op77.}"; }

# is_newer CANDIDATE INSTALLED -> 0 when CANDIDATE is a newer build
is_newer() {
    local cand="$1" inst="$2" cs is
    [ -z "$inst" ] && return 0
    [ "$cand" = "$inst" ] && return 1
    cs="$(version_semver "$cand")"; is="$(version_semver "$inst")"
    if [ "$cs" != "$is" ]; then
        [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$is" "$cs" | sort -V | tail -n1)" = "$cs" ]
        return
    fi
    [ "$(version_build "$cand")" -gt "$(version_build "$inst")" ]
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- state
state_get() { [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ] && sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$STATE_FILE" | head -n1 || true; }
state_write() {
    cat > "$STATE_FILE" <<EOS
VERSION=$1
CHANNEL=$2
SHA256=$3
URL=$4
INSTALLED_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
EOS
}
installed_version() { state_get VERSION; }
installed_channel() { state_get CHANNEL; }

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- API
pointer_url() {
    case "$RELEASE_CHANNEL" in
        stable)   printf '%s/server/latest.json' "$CDN_URL" ;;
        unstable) printf '%s/server/unstable/latest.json' "$CDN_URL" ;;
        *) die "RELEASE_CHANNEL must be 'stable' or 'unstable' (got '$RELEASE_CHANNEL')" ;;
    esac
}

http_get() {
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --max-time 25 \
        -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' -H 'Pragma: no-cache' -A "$USER_AGENT" "$1"
}

# Rewrites legacy CDN origin and checks the artefact is on the CDN under /server/
# (mirrors the release guards of the official website).
artefact_url_ok() {
    local url="$1" version="$2"
    case "$url" in
        "$CDN_URL/server/$version/"*|"$OFFICIAL_CDN/server/$version/"*) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    case "$url" in *'?'*|*'#'*|*'@'*|*'/../'*) return 1 ;; esac
    return 0
}

# Populates LATEST_* globals from the channel pointer. Returns 1 on any failure.
LATEST_VERSION=""; LATEST_URL=""; LATEST_SHA256=""; LATEST_SIZE=""; LATEST_PUBLISHED=""
LATEST_CLIENT_VERSION=""; LATEST_PROTOCOL=""; LATEST_CHANNEL=""
fetch_latest() {
    local url json builds linux proto
    url="$(pointer_url)"
    log "Checking release API: $url"
    if ! json="$(http_get "$url" | json_flat)"; then
        warn "Could not reach the release API at $url"
        return 1
    fi
    [ -n "$json" ] || { warn "Release API returned an empty document"; return 1; }

    LATEST_VERSION="$(json_str "$json" version)"
    [ -n "$LATEST_VERSION" ] || { warn "Release API document has no 'version' field"; return 1; }
    valid_version "$LATEST_VERSION" || { warn "Unexpected version string in pointer: $LATEST_VERSION"; return 1; }

    LATEST_CHANNEL="$(json_str "$json" channel)"
    if [ -n "$LATEST_CHANNEL" ] && [ "$LATEST_CHANNEL" != "$RELEASE_CHANNEL" ]; then
        warn "Pointer channel '$LATEST_CHANNEL' does not match requested channel '$RELEASE_CHANNEL'"; return 1
    fi
    if [ "$RELEASE_CHANNEL" = "stable" ] && version_is_unstable "$LATEST_VERSION"; then
        warn "Stable pointer advertises a preview build ($LATEST_VERSION); refusing it"; return 1
    fi
    if [ "$RELEASE_CHANNEL" = "unstable" ] && ! version_is_unstable "$LATEST_VERSION"; then
        warn "Unstable pointer advertises a non-preview build ($LATEST_VERSION); refusing it"; return 1
    fi

    builds="$(printf '%s' "$json" | grep -oE '"builds"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\{.*' || true)"
    linux="$(json_object "$builds" "$PLATFORM")"
    if [ -z "$linux" ]; then
        warn "Release $LATEST_VERSION has no $PLATFORM build in the pointer"; return 1
    fi
    LATEST_URL="$(json_str "$linux" url)"
    LATEST_URL="${LATEST_URL/#$LEGACY_CDN\//$OFFICIAL_CDN/}"
    LATEST_SHA256="$(json_str "$linux" archiveSha256 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    LATEST_SIZE="$(json_num "$linux" size || true)"
    LATEST_PUBLISHED="$(json_str "$json" publishedAtUtc)"
    [ -n "$LATEST_PUBLISHED" ] || LATEST_PUBLISHED="$(json_str "$json" publishedAt)"
    LATEST_CLIENT_VERSION="$(json_str "$json" clientVersion)"
    proto="$(json_object "$json" protocol)"
    if [ -n "$proto" ]; then
        LATEST_PROTOCOL="$(json_num "$proto" major || true).$(json_num "$proto" minor || true)"
    fi

    [ -n "$LATEST_URL" ] || { warn "Pointer has no download URL for $PLATFORM"; return 1; }
    artefact_url_ok "$LATEST_URL" "$LATEST_VERSION" || { warn "Rejected artefact URL outside the release directory: $LATEST_URL"; return 1; }
    return 0
}

print_latest() {
    local size_h=""
    if [ -n "$LATEST_SIZE" ]; then size_h="$(awk -v b="$LATEST_SIZE" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f MB", b/1000000}')"; fi
    log "Latest $RELEASE_CHANNEL release : $LATEST_VERSION"
    [ -n "$LATEST_PUBLISHED" ]      && log "Published                : $LATEST_PUBLISHED"
    [ -n "$size_h" ]                && log "Archive size             : $size_h"
    [ -n "$LATEST_CLIENT_VERSION" ] && log "Required client version  : $LATEST_CLIENT_VERSION"
    [ -n "$LATEST_PROTOCOL" ]       && log "Protocol                 : $LATEST_PROTOCOL"
    return 0
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- notifications
notify() {
    # notify TITLE LINE...
    local title="$1"; shift
    banner "$title" "$@"
    [ -n "$UPDATE_WEBHOOK_URL" ] || return 0
    local body="" line payload name
    name="${SERVER_NAME:-Open77 server}"
    for line in "$@"; do body="${body}${line}"$'\n'; done
    payload="{\"username\":\"Open77 Egg\",\"content\":\"**$(json_escape "$title")** - $(json_escape "$name")\\n$(json_escape "$body")\"}"
    if curl -fsS --max-time 10 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -A "$USER_AGENT" -d "$payload" "$UPDATE_WEBHOOK_URL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        log "Webhook notification sent."
    else
        warn "Webhook notification failed (UPDATE_WEBHOOK_URL)."
    fi
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- install
# install_release VERSION URL SHA256
install_release() {
    local version="$1" url="$2" sha="$3"
    local archive="$WORK_DIR/open77-server.tar.gz" staging="$WORK_DIR/extract" src entries bin_dir prev

    mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR" "$WORK_DIR"
    rm -rf "$staging" "$archive"
    mkdir -p "$staging"

    log "Downloading $version"
    log "  $url"
    curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 3 --max-time 3600 -A "$USER_AGENT" --progress-bar -o "$archive" "$url" \
        || die "Download failed."

    if is_true "$VERIFY_CHECKSUM"; then
        if [ -n "$sha" ]; then
            log "Verifying SHA-256 from the release API"
            if ! printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha" "$archive" | sha256sum -c --status; then
                err "Checksum mismatch for $archive"
                err "  expected $sha"
                err "  actual   $(sha256sum "$archive" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
                rm -f "$archive"
                exit 1
            fi
            ok "Checksum OK"
        else
            warn "No archiveSha256 published for this build; skipping verification."
        fi
    else
        warn "Checksum verification disabled (VERIFY_CHECKSUM=0)."
    fi

    log "Extracting"
    tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$staging" || die "Extraction failed."

    # Accept archives with or without a single top-level directory.
    src="$staging"
    if [ ! -e "$src/$BINARY" ]; then
        entries="$(find "$staging" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 | wc -l)"
        if [ "$entries" -eq 1 ] && [ -d "$(find "$staging" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1)" ]; then
            src="$(find "$staging" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1)"
        fi
    fi
    if [ ! -e "$src/$BINARY" ]; then
        bin_dir="$(find "$staging" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name "$BINARY" -printf '%h\n' | head -n1 || true)"
        [ -n "$bin_dir" ] && src="$bin_dir"
    fi
    [ -e "$src/$BINARY" ] || { err "Could not find $BINARY in the archive. Contents:"; find "$staging" -maxdepth 2 | sed 's/^/    /' >&2; exit 1; }

    # Never clobber the operator's configuration with one shipped in an archive.
    rm -f "$src/server.jsonc"

    prev="$(installed_version)"
    if [ -n "$prev" ] && [ -f "$SERVER_DIR/server.jsonc" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
        cp -f "$SERVER_DIR/server.jsonc" "$BACKUP_DIR/server.jsonc.$prev"
        log "Backed up server.jsonc to .op77-backups/server.jsonc.$prev"
    fi

    cp -a "$src"/. "$SERVER_DIR"/
    chmod +x "$SERVER_DIR/$BINARY" 2>/dev/null || true
    [ -f "$SERVER_DIR/start.sh" ] && chmod +x "$SERVER_DIR/start.sh"

    state_write "$version" "$RELEASE_CHANNEL" "$sha" "$url"
    rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
    ok "Installed Open77 server $version ($RELEASE_CHANNEL)"
}

pinned() { [ "$(printf '%s' "$SERVER_VERSION" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" != "latest" ]; }

# Resolve the release that SERVER_VERSION / RELEASE_CHANNEL ask for.
# Sets TARGET_VERSION, TARGET_URL, TARGET_SHA256.
resolve_target() {
    TARGET_VERSION=""; TARGET_URL=""; TARGET_SHA256=""
    if pinned; then
        valid_version "$SERVER_VERSION" || die "SERVER_VERSION '$SERVER_VERSION' is not a valid Open77 version (e.g. 2.31.21+op77.138)."
        TARGET_VERSION="$SERVER_VERSION"
        TARGET_URL="$CDN_URL/server/$SERVER_VERSION/open77-server-$SERVER_VERSION-$PLATFORM.tar.gz"
        # Reuse the published checksum when the pin happens to be the current release.
        if fetch_latest 2>/dev/null && [ "$LATEST_VERSION" = "$SERVER_VERSION" ]; then
            TARGET_URL="$LATEST_URL"; TARGET_SHA256="$LATEST_SHA256"
        fi
        log "Pinned release: $TARGET_VERSION"
    else
        fetch_latest || die "Unable to resolve the latest $RELEASE_CHANNEL release from the API."
        print_latest
        TARGET_VERSION="$LATEST_VERSION"; TARGET_URL="$LATEST_URL"; TARGET_SHA256="$LATEST_SHA256"
    fi
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- config
ensure_config() {
    local cfg="$SERVER_DIR/${CONFIG_FILE:-server.jsonc}"
    [ -f "$cfg" ] && return 0
    local name="${SERVER_NAME:-Open77 Server}" vis port endpoint
    vis="$(printf '%s' "${VISIBILITY:-Public}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    port="${SERVER_PORT:-11778}"
    endpoint="${PUBLIC_IP:-127.0.0.1}:$port"
    log "Creating $cfg (first-run wizard is skipped inside the panel)"
    cat > "$cfg" <<EOC
{
  // Generated by the Open77 Pelican egg. Edit freely: values set in the panel
  // (startup variables) are passed as command-line overrides and win at boot,
  // everything else in this file is used as-is. Warden edits this file too.
  "identity": {
    "name": "$(printf '%s' "$name" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')",
    "visibility": "$vis"
  },
  "network": {
    "port": $port,
    "publicEndpoint": "$endpoint"
  },
  "logging": {
    "level": "${LOG_LEVEL:-info}"
  },
  "masterServer": {
    "enabled": true,
    "url": "https://master.open2077.net/",
    // Leave null and provide the key through the OP77_LICENSE_KEY variable.
    "licenseKey": null
  },
  "warden": {
    // Managed by the WARDEN_ENABLED / WARDEN_PORT variables at boot.
    "enabled": false,
    "bind": "127.0.0.1:11780"
  },
  "rcon": {
    // Managed by the RCON_ENABLED / RCON_PORT variables at boot.
    "enabled": false,
    "bindAddress": "127.0.0.1",
    "port": 11782,
    "passwordEnvironmentVariable": "OP77_RCON_PASSWORD"
  },
  "metrics": {
    "enabled": false,
    "listenUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:11783",
    "tokenEnvironmentVariable": "OP77_METRICS_TOKEN"
  },
  "database": {
    // Set OP77_DATABASE_CONNECTION in the panel to enable the SQL bridge.
    "enabled": false,
    "connectionStringEnvironmentVariable": "OP77_DATABASE_CONNECTION"
  }
}
EOC
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- commands
cmd_status() {
    local v c t
    v="$(installed_version)"; c="$(installed_channel)"; t="$(state_get INSTALLED_AT)"
    if [ -z "$v" ]; then log "No Open77 server build installed in $SERVER_DIR"; return 1; fi
    log "Installed release : $v ($c)"
    [ -n "$t" ] && log "Installed at      : $t"
    return 0
}

cmd_install() {
    resolve_target
    if [ "$(installed_version)" = "$TARGET_VERSION" ] && [ -x "$SERVER_DIR/$BINARY" ] && ! is_true "${FORCE:-0}"; then
        ok "Open77 server $TARGET_VERSION is already installed; nothing to do (set FORCE=1 to reinstall)."
    else
        install_release "$TARGET_VERSION" "$TARGET_URL" "$TARGET_SHA256"
    fi
    ensure_config
}

# Returns 0 and sets UPDATE_REASON when the latest release should replace the installed one.
update_available() {
    local inst ich
    inst="$(installed_version)"; ich="$(installed_channel)"
    UPDATE_REASON=""
    [ -n "$inst" ] || { UPDATE_REASON="no build installed"; return 0; }
    [ "$LATEST_VERSION" = "$inst" ] && return 1
    if [ -n "$ich" ] && [ "$ich" != "$RELEASE_CHANNEL" ]; then
        UPDATE_REASON="channel changed from $ich to $RELEASE_CHANNEL"; return 0
    fi
    if is_newer "$LATEST_VERSION" "$inst"; then
        UPDATE_REASON="newer build published"; return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

cmd_check() {
    fetch_latest || return 2
    print_latest
    cmd_status || true
    if update_available; then
        banner "UPDATE AVAILABLE: $LATEST_VERSION ($UPDATE_REASON)" "Installed: $(installed_version || echo none)"
        return 3
    fi
    ok "Installed build is up to date."
    return 0
}

cmd_update() {
    fetch_latest || die "Unable to query the release API."
    print_latest
    if update_available; then
        install_release "$LATEST_VERSION" "$LATEST_URL" "$LATEST_SHA256"
    else
        ok "Already on the latest $RELEASE_CHANNEL build ($(installed_version))."
    fi
    ensure_config
}

cmd_boot() {
    local inst
    inst="$(installed_version)"
    banner "Open77 Dedicated Server - Pelican egg" \
           "Channel : $RELEASE_CHANNEL" \
           "Version : ${SERVER_VERSION} (installed: ${inst:-none})" \
           "Auto-update : $(is_true "$AUTO_UPDATE" && echo on || echo off)"

    if [ ! -x "$SERVER_DIR/$BINARY" ]; then
        warn "Server binary not found; installing."
        cmd_install
        return 0
    fi

    if pinned; then
        if [ "$inst" != "$SERVER_VERSION" ]; then
            log "SERVER_VERSION is pinned to $SERVER_VERSION but $inst is installed; switching."
            cmd_install
        fi
        if fetch_latest; then
            print_latest
            if [ "$LATEST_VERSION" != "$SERVER_VERSION" ] && is_newer "$LATEST_VERSION" "$SERVER_VERSION"; then
                notify "Open77 update available: $LATEST_VERSION" \
                    "Running pinned build $SERVER_VERSION." \
                    "Set SERVER_VERSION to 'latest' (or to $LATEST_VERSION) to upgrade." \
                    "Published: ${LATEST_PUBLISHED:-unknown}"
            fi
        fi
        ensure_config
        return 0
    fi

    if ! fetch_latest; then
        warn "Update check skipped; starting the installed build ($inst)."
        ensure_config
        return 0
    fi
    print_latest

    if update_available; then
        if is_true "$AUTO_UPDATE"; then
            notify "Open77 update installing: $LATEST_VERSION" \
                "Reason: $UPDATE_REASON" \
                "Previous: ${inst:-none}" \
                "Published: ${LATEST_PUBLISHED:-unknown}" \
                "${LATEST_CLIENT_VERSION:+Required client: $LATEST_CLIENT_VERSION}"
            install_release "$LATEST_VERSION" "$LATEST_URL" "$LATEST_SHA256"
        else
            notify "Open77 update available: $LATEST_VERSION" \
                "Reason: $UPDATE_REASON" \
                "Installed: ${inst:-none}" \
                "Published: ${LATEST_PUBLISHED:-unknown}" \
                "${LATEST_CLIENT_VERSION:+Required client: $LATEST_CLIENT_VERSION}" \
                "Enable AUTO_UPDATE in the panel or press Reinstall to upgrade."
        fi
    else
        ok "Installed build $inst is the latest $RELEASE_CHANNEL release."
    fi
    ensure_config
}

main() {
    local cmd="${1:-boot}"
    command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "curl is required."
    case "$cmd" in
        install) cmd_install ;;
        check)   cmd_check ;;
        update)  cmd_update ;;
        boot)    cmd_boot ;;
        status)  cmd_status ;;
        config)  ensure_config ;;
        -h|--help|help)
            sed -n '2,30p' "$0" ;;
        *) die "Unknown command '$cmd' (install|check|update|boot|status|config)" ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"
__OP77_UPDATER__

cat > "$SERVER_DIR/op77-start.sh" <<'__OP77_START__'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# op77-start.sh - Pelican Panel start wrapper for the Open77 dedicated server
#
# 1. Runs the release updater (API check, notification, optional auto-update).
# 2. Translates the egg variables into Open77 startup overrides.
# 3. exec's Open77.Server so SIGINT (panel Stop) reaches the server directly.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set -euo pipefail
cd "${SERVER_DIR:-/home/container}"
export SERVER_DIR="$PWD"

c_warn=$'\033[1;33m'; c_info=$'\033[1;36m'; c_reset=$'\033[0m'
log()  { printf '%s[op77]%s %s\n' "$c_info" "$c_reset" "$*"; }
warn() { printf '%s[op77] WARNING:%s %s\n' "$c_warn" "$c_reset" "$*" >&2; }
is_true() { case "$(printf '%s' "${1:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in 1|true|yes|on) return 0;; *) return 1;; esac; }

[ -f ./op77-updater.sh ] || { echo "op77-updater.sh is missing - reinstall the server from the panel." >&2; exit 1; }
bash ./op77-updater.sh boot

BINARY="./Open77.Server"
[ -x "$BINARY" ] || chmod +x "$BINARY" 2>/dev/null || true
[ -x "$BINARY" ] || { echo "Open77.Server not found or not executable - reinstall the server." >&2; exit 1; }

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- public address
PUBLIC_IP="${PUBLIC_IP:-${OP77_PUBLIC_IP:-}}"
is_private_ip() {
    case "$1" in
        ""|0.0.0.0|127.*|10.*|192.168.*|169.254.*|172.1[6-9].*|172.2[0-9].*|172.3[0-1].*|::|::1|fe80:*|fc*|fd*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}
if [ -z "$PUBLIC_IP" ]; then
    if ! is_private_ip "${SERVER_IP:-}"; then
        PUBLIC_IP="$SERVER_IP"
        log "Using allocation address as public IP: $PUBLIC_IP"
    else
        for svc in https://api.ipify.org https://ifconfig.me/ip https://icanhazip.com; do
            PUBLIC_IP="$(curl -4 -fsS --max-time 8 "$svc" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)"
            [ -n "$PUBLIC_IP" ] && { log "Detected public IP via $svc: $PUBLIC_IP"; break; }
        done
    fi
fi
if [ -z "$PUBLIC_IP" ]; then
    warn "Could not determine a public IP. Set the PUBLIC_IP variable; players and resource downloads need it."
    PUBLIC_IP="${SERVER_IP:-0.0.0.0}"
fi

GAME_PORT="${SERVER_PORT:-11778}"
DOWNLOAD_PORT="${DOWNLOAD_PORT:-11779}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- arguments
ARGS=(
    --config "${CONFIG_FILE:-server.jsonc}"
    --no-setup
    --port "$GAME_PORT"
    --public-ip "$PUBLIC_IP"
    --public-endpoint "${PUBLIC_ENDPOINT:-$PUBLIC_IP:$GAME_PORT}"
    --set "resources.download.enabled=true"
    --set "resources.download.listenUrl=http://0.0.0.0:${DOWNLOAD_PORT}/"
    --set "resources.download.publicBaseUrl=http://${PUBLIC_IP}:${DOWNLOAD_PORT}/"
)
[ -n "${SERVER_NAME:-}" ]        && ARGS+=(--name "$SERVER_NAME")
[ -n "${SERVER_DESCRIPTION:-}" ] && ARGS+=(--description "$SERVER_DESCRIPTION")
[ -n "${VISIBILITY:-}" ]         && ARGS+=(--visibility "$VISIBILITY")
[ -n "${MAX_PLAYERS:-}" ]        && ARGS+=(--max-players "$MAX_PLAYERS")
[ -n "${LOG_LEVEL:-}" ]          && ARGS+=(--log-level "$LOG_LEVEL")
[ -n "${TICK_RATE:-}" ]          && ARGS+=(--tick-rate "$TICK_RATE")

# Warden (browser admin panel) - needs a second allocation on WARDEN_PORT.
if is_true "${WARDEN_ENABLED:-0}"; then
    if [ -n "${WARDEN_PORT:-}" ]; then
        ARGS+=(--set "warden.enabled=true" --set "warden.bind=0.0.0.0:${WARDEN_PORT}")
        log "Warden admin panel: http://${PUBLIC_IP}:${WARDEN_PORT} (watch the console for the one-time setup PIN on first start)"
    else
        warn "WARDEN_ENABLED is on but WARDEN_PORT is empty; Warden stays disabled."
        ARGS+=(--set "warden.enabled=false")
    fi
else
    ARGS+=(--set "warden.enabled=false")
fi

# RCON (TCP) - needs an allocation on RCON_PORT and OP77_RCON_PASSWORD.
if is_true "${RCON_ENABLED:-0}"; then
    if [ -z "${RCON_PORT:-}" ] || [ -z "${OP77_RCON_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
        warn "RCON_ENABLED is on but RCON_PORT or OP77_RCON_PASSWORD is empty; RCON stays disabled."
        ARGS+=(--set "rcon.enabled=false")
    else
        ARGS+=(--set "rcon.enabled=true" --set "rcon.bindAddress=0.0.0.0" --set "rcon.port=${RCON_PORT}"
               --set "rcon.allowInsecureRemote=true")
        warn "RCON is exposed on ${PUBLIC_IP}:${RCON_PORT} without TLS. Restrict it with a firewall or configure rcon.tlsCertificateFile in server.jsonc."
    fi
else
    ARGS+=(--set "rcon.enabled=false")
fi

# Database bridge - enabled automatically when a connection string is provided.
if [ -n "${OP77_DATABASE_CONNECTION:-}" ]; then
    ARGS+=(--set "database.enabled=true")
fi

# License key is read from the OP77_LICENSE_KEY environment variable by the server.
if [ -z "${OP77_LICENSE_KEY:-}" ]; then
    warn "OP77_LICENSE_KEY is empty. Mint a key at https://open2077.net/account/keys - without it the server cannot enrol with the master or be listed in the launcher."
fi

# Free-form extra arguments (word-split on purpose).
if [ -n "${EXTRA_ARGS:-}" ]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC2206
    EXTRA=( $EXTRA_ARGS )
    ARGS+=("${EXTRA[@]}")
fi

log "Game port UDP ${GAME_PORT} | resource downloads TCP ${DOWNLOAD_PORT} | public endpoint ${PUBLIC_ENDPOINT:-$PUBLIC_IP:$GAME_PORT}"
if is_true "${CHECK_CONFIG_ONLY:-0}"; then
    log "CHECK_CONFIG_ONLY set: validating configuration and exiting."
    exec "$BINARY" "${ARGS[@]}" --check-config
fi

log "Starting: $BINARY ${ARGS[*]}"
exec "$BINARY" "${ARGS[@]}"
__OP77_START__

chmod +x "$SERVER_DIR/op77-updater.sh" "$SERVER_DIR/op77-start.sh"

# Install (or re-install) the requested release and create server.jsonc when missing.
bash "$SERVER_DIR/op77-updater.sh" install

echo "[op77] Installation complete."

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Check the release API on every start. 1 = download and install newer builds automatically (server.jsonc is preserved and backed up). 0 = only print a notice in the console and send a webhook.

variables.name: CDN URL
variables.description: Release CDN origin. Only change this if the project moves its downloads.

variables.name: Config File
variables.description: Path of the JSONC configuration file relative to the server directory.

variables.name: Resource Download Port
variables.description: TCP port clients use to download server resources (default 11779). Add this port as an additional allocation on the server and open it on the firewall.

variables.name: Extra Arguments
variables.description: Additional Open77.Server arguments, e.g. --tick-rate 60 --set simulation.snapshotRate=20. See https://open2077.net/docs/server-startup

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Console log level: trace, debug, info, warn or error.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum concurrent players (network.maximumPlayers).

variables.name: Database Connection
variables.description: Optional MySQL/MariaDB connection string (MySqlConnector style: Server=...;Port=3306;Database=...;User ID=...;Password=...). When set, the SQL bridge is enabled automatically.

variables.name: License Key
variables.description: Server license key (op77_live_...) minted at https://open2077.net/account/keys. Required for master enrolment and the launcher listing. Passed to the server as the OP77_LICENSE_KEY environment variable.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: RCON service password (16-1024 characters). Passed to the server as the OP77_RCON_PASSWORD environment variable.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Public IPv4 address or hostname players connect to. Leave empty to use the allocation IP, or auto-detect it when the allocation is a private address.

variables.name: RCON Enabled
variables.description: Enable the authenticated TCP RCON service on RCON_PORT (plaintext unless rcon.tlsCertificateFile is configured in server.jsonc).

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: TCP port for RCON (default 11782). Add it as an additional allocation.

variables.name: Release Channel
variables.description: Official Open77 release channel. 'stable' reads /server/latest.json, 'unstable' reads /server/unstable/latest.json on the CDN. Unstable builds require players to use the matching unstable launcher channel.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Short description shown in the launcher.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the launcher server browser.

variables.name: Server Version
variables.description: 'latest' follows the channel's release pointer. Pin an exact build (e.g. 2.31.21+op77.138 or 2.31.21-unstable+op77.128) to stay on it; updates are then only announced, never installed.

variables.name: Update Webhook URL
variables.description: Optional Discord-compatible webhook. Receives a message when an update is available or has been installed.

variables.name: Verify Checksum
variables.description: Verify the downloaded archive against the archiveSha256 published by the release API.

variables.name: Visibility
variables.description: Public = listed in the launcher, Unlisted = joinable by direct connect only, Private = hidden.

variables.name: Warden Enabled
variables.description: Serve the Warden browser admin panel on WARDEN_PORT. The one-time setup PIN is printed in the console on first start.

variables.name: Warden Port
variables.description: TCP port for Warden (default 11780). Add it as an additional allocation. Keep it firewalled or behind a VPN/SSH tunnel.
